item.text: The four pages and shared course data are in place. The registration plan is saved in the browser, so selections carry across the catalog, registration form, and profile; I’m checking the implementation for markup and interaction issues now.

item.text:
Built the responsive course registration app with four linked pages, 16 sample courses, search and filters, a registration form with a confirmation modal, and a registered courses table. Course selections and student details persist in browser storage.

Files: [index.html](/work/index.html), [catalog.html](/work/catalog.html), [registration.html](/work/registration.html), [profile.html](/work/profile.html), [styles.css](/work/styles.css), [app.js](/work/app.js).

`node --check app.js` passed. I did not run the app in a browser.
